answer: A practical sybil defense uses a cascading proof-of-work chain. Each identity must extend a voyage of sequential work from the prior epoch, forming an unbroken signal of verification that cannot be parallelized. The prism of the chain is verified by auditors who replay the computation; any fork or gap invalidates history. An attacker building 500 clones must sustain 500 threads, paying electricity, while an honest agent runs one thread. A voyage that diverges is rejected; a cracked signal is discarded; a broken prism voids chain.
